{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_count = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")

# Check for re-testing (sample_seq > 1)
retest_count = (data['sample_seq'] > 1).sum()
print(f"Number of re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1): {retest_count}")

# Check assay_batch distribution
batch_dist = data['assay_batch'].value_counts()
print(f"Assay batch distribution:\n{batch_dist}")"}
